title: McLeodganj, Triund & Bir
reportingPoint: Departure is in the evening from Delhi. The exact pickup point and time are shared once your booking is confirmed. Pickup from Chandigarh is also available.
highlights: Triund trek with a night in camps at Triund top
Bhagsu waterfall, Dalai Lama Monastery and the McLeodganj flea market
Dharamshala HPCA stadium, Palampur tea garden and Baijnath temple on the way to Bir
Bonfire with light music in Bir
Bir Billing, with optional paragliding (extra cost)
overview:
A long weekend across three stops in Himachal Pradesh: this **3 Nights / 4 Days** McLeodganj, Triund and Bir group trip leaves Delhi in the evening, with pickup from Chandigarh as well. It is an overnight journey to McLeodganj with a dinner halt on the way (dinner at your own cost).

Day 1 is in McLeodganj: the flea market, Bhagsu waterfall, the Dalai Lama Monastery and the cafes, with a night in a hotel. Day 2 is the Triund trek, ending with a night in camps at Triund. Day 3 treks back down and drives to Bir via the Dharamshala HPCA stadium, Palampur tea garden and Baijnath temple, with a bonfire in the evening. Day 4 is for Bir Billing, where paragliding is available at extra cost, before the evening departure. Transport, three nights of stay, 3 breakfasts and 3 dinners are included. Prices start at ₹9,999 per person on triple sharing (5% GST extra).

itinerary.title: Departure from Delhi / Chandigarh
itinerary.content:
Departure in the evening.
Overnight journey to McLeodganj.
Halt for dinner on the way (not included).

itinerary.title: McLeodganj exploration | Dalai Lama Monastery
itinerary.content:
Reach McLeodganj, check in to the hotel and freshen up.
After some rest, explore the McLeodganj flea market.
Visit Bhagsu waterfall, the Dalai Lama Monastery and the cafes.
Return to the hotel.
Dinner and overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Triund trek | Camping
itinerary.content:
Freshen up and have breakfast.
Start the Triund trek.
Triund sits in the Dhauladhar mountains, with the Dhauladhar range on one side and the Kangra valley on the other.
Reach Triund in the evening and check in to the camps.
Dinner and overnight stay at the camps.

itinerary.title: Triund to Bir
itinerary.content:
Have breakfast and trek down.
Collect your luggage from the hotel.
Leave for Bir, visiting the Dharamshala HPCA stadium, Palampur tea garden and Baijnath temple on the way.
Reach Bir in the evening and check in to the homestay.
Enjoy a bonfire with some light music.
Dinner and overnight stay at Bir.

itinerary.title: Bir Billing | Paragliding | Departure
itinerary.content:
Wake up early and have breakfast.
Head towards the Billing paragliding take-off site (paragliding costs extra).
The flight takes off from Billing and lands in Bir, and takes around 15 to 30 minutes.
Spend some time enjoying the views in Bir.
Departure in the evening, followed by an overnight journey back.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government-approved photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Also pack comfortable clothes, sports or trekking shoes, a warm layer for the season, personal medicines and some cash. The full list is under Things To Pack.
